blog.author: Basqat Team
blog.title: How to Launch Your Digital Product with Confidence in 8 Weeks
blog.description: In this article, we share a practical methodology to speed up digital product launches, from market testing to your first paying customer, with real examples and actionable tips.
blog.quote: “A successful launch starts with understanding the customer, building a lightweight solution, measuring impact, and iterating improvements.”

section1.title: 1) Rapid Market Testing
section1.content: Start with clear hypotheses about the problem and target audience, then test with simple messages and small ads to track engagement before building the product.

section2.title: 2) Build a Lightweight First Version
section2.content: Focus on a core feature that solves the biggest pain, and use ready-made tools to reduce development time and cost.

section3.title: 3) Set Up Your Sales Funnel
section3.content: Use a clear landing page, a concise value proposition, social proof, and a booking form or free trial to gather early customers.
